conclusions.defect_origin: All eight I bad geometries already exist in frozen B0 construction; G and P retain exactly those defects. R also has ten geometry-invalid cases in this small cohort.

conclusions.repair_design_limitation: Formula/contact-order pointer selects species order but static first native slot is not a conflict detector. Current two anchors leave at least one immutable bad pair in every bad structure.
conclusions.global_gate_conflict: Every bad-case local proposal had nonempty XYZ support; all16 per arm rolled back at final whole-structure gate. Six separate proposals per arm removed an existing active conflict without introducing new ones, but were rejected due to unrelated bad pairs.
conclusions.implementation_bug_evidence: No observed wrong checkpoint for construction, altered Plan/seed, controller failure, wrong slot mapping, nonactive write, empty support, or token-ID/coordinate-scale mismatch. The whole-structure gate is a confirmed design-level mismatch for incremental repair, not an undiscovered coding branch malfunction.
